subject: FY26 Property Revaluation and Statutory Exemptions
overview: The Board approved a variety of statutory tax exemptions and motor vehicle excise abatements while preparing for the upcoming fiscal year 2026 property revaluation. Members also moved to clear a backlog of uncollectible personal property taxes dating back to 2004.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Agenda Modification
items.summary: The Board approved the June meeting minutes and added the cleanup of uncollectible personal property taxes to the current agenda as an unanticipated item.

items.title: Motor Vehicle Excise Abatements and Commitments
items.summary: Approved various motor vehicle excise tax abatements and the fourth excise commitment.

items.title: Statutory Exemptions and Denials
items.summary: Approved numerous statutory exemptions for veterans, seniors, and Community Preservation Act applicants while denying three applications that exceeded income or asset limits.

items.title: Uncollectible Personal Property Write-offs
items.summary: Approved the write-off of personal property taxes from fiscal years 2004 through 2022 that the Treasurer-Collector deemed uncollectible.

items.title: FY26 Revaluation Update
items.summary: The Board reviewed preliminary data for the recertification year, noting residential increases of 2% to 7% while commercial values remain largely flat.

items.title: Public Disclosure Notification Methods
items.summary: Approved a motion to investigate using tax bill inserts or memos to better notify taxpayers of preliminary property values prior to the mandatory public disclosure period.
